kind_definitions.fixed: Direct reference to a named page by ref.
kind_definitions.all: Every URL of the given archetype.
kind_definitions.siblings_same_service: Other service-area-service pages sharing this service.
kind_definitions.siblings_same_area: Other service-area-service pages sharing this area.
kind_definitions.cousins_same_service: Service-area-service pages with same service, different area.
kind_definitions.children_same_area: Service-area-service pages whose parent is this area.
kind_definitions.geographic_neighbors: Other service-area pages within N miles (computed at plan time when lat/lng given; else by state/county adjacency).
kind_definitions.parent_service: The service-landing page corresponding to this service-area-service's service slug.
kind_definitions.parent_area: The service-area page corresponding to this service-area-service's area slug.
kind_definitions.related_services: Service-landing pages with overlapping secondary keywords.
kind_definitions.related_blog_posts: Blog posts tagged with at least one service this page covers.
kind_definitions.tagged_services: Service-landing pages tagged in the blog post's services[] array.
